questions.stem_text:
There is a grand jury proceeding underway for a local businessman. What is not true about
grand jury proceedings?

options.A: The proceedings are conducted in secret.
options.B: There is no right to counsel.
options.C: There is a right to Miranda warnings.
options.D: There is no right to have evidence excluded.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - There is a right to Miranda warnings.

questions.stem_text: Which of the following constitutional provisions is applicable to corporations?

options.A: The privileges and immunities clause of the Fourteenth Amendment.
options.B: The comity clause of Article IV.
options.C: The Fifth Amendment's prohibition against compulsory self-incrimination.
options.D: The equal protection clause of the Fourteenth Amendment.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - The equal protection clause of the Fourteenth Amendment.

questions.stem_text: A merchant's irrevocable written offer (firm offer) to sell goods

options.A: Must be separately signed if the offeree supplies a form contract containing the offer.
options.D: Can not exceed a three-month duration even if consideration is given.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Must be separately signed if the offeree supplies a form contract containing the offer.

questions.stem_text:
A criminal actor committed the crime of solicitation. Which of the following does not
apply to solicitation?

options.A: It is an agreement between two or more to commit a crime.
options.B: It is solicitation of another to commit a felony.
options.C: No act is needed other than the solicitation.
options.D: Withdrawal is generally not a defense.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - It is an agreement between two or more to commit a crime.

questions.stem_text:
In which instance would a state, under the enabling clause of the Fourteenth Amendment, be
most able to regulate?

options.A: A private individual from discriminating against a person based on race.
options.B: A private individual from discriminating against a person based on nationality.
options.C: A state official from discriminating against a person based on race.
options.D: A federal official from discriminating against a person based on nationality.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - A state official from discriminating against a person based on race.
